name: What is the typical deposit structure for a new development condo in Miami-Dade County?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical deposit structure for a new development condo in Miami-Dade County?

acceptedAnswer.text: Deposit structures for new development condos in Miami-Dade County usually involve multiple payments spread across the construction timeline, not just a single down payment at closing. Developers often require an initial deposit upon contract signing, followed by additional payments at various construction milestones, such as foundation completion, top-off, and final completion. Understanding this phased payment schedule is crucial for budgeting and financial planning throughout the purchasing process.
acceptedAnswer.description: New development condos in Miami-Dade County typically have a phased deposit structure with multiple payments tied to construction milestones.
